human_review.action: Resolve the A/B source-to-NC conflict and the 6 mm stock versus 30 mm design-height scope; verify machine, controller, material, tool availability, holder, workholding, WCS and CAM/post versions; obtain current simulation and qualified review of this exact NC artifact.
